ROOT_CAUSE:
The order asked for BUILD_STARTED evidence and inherited a hypothesis about a gap between the quick-panel row, the building page, the prerequisites, the upgrade execution and the queue verifier. Reading the real episodes turned that into three separate facts, and only one of them was a defect I could fix without inventing evidence.

(1) FIXED -- the entry hop had no consumer. `OPEN_BUILDING_UPGRADE` failed three times, identically: 05:11:45, 05:51:29 and 06:39:54, every one `SEMANTIC_TARGET_NOT_VERIFIED`, duration 0.157-0.172 s, empty after_screenshot, so none of them reached the device. Each one's own state_before carried the answer: {"name": "城墙", "level": 8, "target_level": 9, "upgrade_tap_norm": [0.4993, 0.7191] / [0.5, 0.7195]}. The brain emits this hop only when that field exists (brain.py:1601, brain.py:1741), the verifier for the opened sheet exists (runtime.py:467), and the producer was already covered by a green test (test_building_action_gate_fallback pins name 城墙 and upgrade_tap_norm [0.5, 0.7203] from boxes read off the real frame). `BTN_SELECTED_BUILDING_UPGRADE` was named in exactly one place in the whole runtime -- the skill's own Action at skills.py:679 -- so _resolve_semantic_target fell through, answered nothing, and the answer sat unread in the frame that produced the question. That is SEMANTIC_TARGET_NOT_VERIFIED, the project's largest failure family (366 rows, 20 skills), in its cheapest possible form.

(2) FOUND, NOT FIXED -- the queue-start proof is unsatisfiable as written. verify_building_upgrade (verifier.py:1631) requires `after.building.get("queue_building") == building_id`. An AST scan of winter_agent_v2 finds NO writer of that key anywhere: the only three mentions are the two reads at verifier.py:1634/1636 and a comment at vision.py:2093. The fabricated producer the project deleted on 2026-09-17 (CAP-B01, "删掉 vision.py 两条伪造常量 STOREHOUSE 26->27 / queue_building") was the only thing that ever set it. So target_ok is always False -- the other half, `before.building["id"] == building_id`, is injected from the same field and is trivially true -- and the skill can never pass, which is consistent with BUILDING_UPGRADE appearing under "Never executed skills" in docs/CURRENT_TRUTH.md §G. Building this out is a decision about what the client's own evidence for a started upgrade is, not a mechanical repair, and the order forbids buying a proof with something weaker, so it is recorded rather than patched.

The actual producer is also in a different vocabulary: ocr.py:2893-2926 emits per building queue {name, timer, status, queue_available, source_word} where `name` is the client's printed label (e.g. 使馆) and status is IN_PROGRESS/COMPLETED/IDLE. The verifier compares `queue_building` to an internal id. Even a rename would not join them; the two halves are keyed by different vocabularies, the same shape as the icon_label_controls / template_manifest split closed in an earlier round.

(3) FOUND, NOT FIXED -- 城墙 has no id. building_identity.BUILDING_IDS has no 城墙 entry (its own rule is "exact match only; every entry names its evidence", and it deliberately omits 盾兵营 for lack of proof), and knowledge/game/buildings.json holds 13 CONFIRMED buildings, none of them the city wall. The id is not needed for the hop this round fixed, but it is needed by (2), so it is on the path. No honest id exists in the repo, so none was invented.
